about: Findings of scripts/mutation/mutate.py that have been examined, each with its class (docs/STATEMENT_MUTATION.md). A finding not listed here fails the run, and so, in --full, does an entry no longer found.

classes.equivalent (renaming): Equivalent mutant: two variables exchanged throughout a schematic statement, which is the same proposition under another naming. The proof is a natural-deduction script (`ofPf <| by unfold …; split_iff; …`) that names its hypotheses by position (`hy n`) and no formula, so it proves the renamed statement as well. Not a fidelity problem; the script is still tied to the connectives: every non-renaming mutant of the same statement fails.
